name: errors-astype-in-a-dependency
description: A dependency that declares an interface embedding error, or declaring its Error method, asserts it through errors.AsType or errors.As on an error the program returns to it, so a type the program converts to error keeps each method by which the converted type itself implements an interface that dependency asserts, and a directive on such a method holds nothing and is stale. A method of an interface the dependency declares and never asserts, a type that implements the asserted interface but never reaches error, and a pointer method of a type that reaches error only as a value keep nothing on that account.
